name: Parents Landing Page
nextAction: Name an owner and checkpoint date, approve the positioning direction and headline pair (H1 vs H2), and send the blocking questions (parent-pays, parent-facing features, referral tracking) to product and eng
description: Learn whether we can reach and earn the trust of parents of college students. A landing page positioned as "the AI study tool that makes your student do the work," with a primary CTA to send Athena to the student (student starts their own trial) and a secondary parent email capture. Success is students activated via a parent referral, not parent signups. Tested through cheap relational channels, not paid-first.

tasks.title: Draft positioning direction and director review (GTM, PMM, product design)

Approve positioning direction and pick the headline pair to test (H1 vs H2)

Confirm age and terms scope (college students only) with legal/product; get Instructure comms sign-off on boilerplate wording
Run 5 to 8 parent conversations (parents of current and first-year students) in parallel with copy drafting
Draft page copy, then review with the messaging-review skill and the copy director
Design, build, and instrument the page (mobile first; referral tag through trial start and activation)
Run a cheap relational channel test (campus parent orgs/newsletters, orientation contacts, student-to-parent referral); log in reference/traction-channels.md
